text: The default setup does not distinguish them: `InitDefaultHelpFlag` creates one boolean `help` flag with shorthand `h`, so `-h` and `--help` address the same flag (`command.go:1183-1201`). To customize help, replace the default setup: Cobra skips creating it if a `help` flag already exists, and the help behavior itself can be overridden through `HelpFunc` (`command.go:1183-1187,470-476`).
